summary: Quick-view modal component and subcategory page wiring appear to be added, and header/footer logos were updated to the requested asset. However, the diff also includes several unrelated UI/content refactors (taxonomy/category hierarchy, global typography/spacing, footer attribution) that were not requested. Additionally, the modal animation only defines the opening fade+scale; the requested smooth reverse animation on close is not evidenced.

missing_requirements.requirement: Modal close animation should smoothly reverse (fade+scale back) with ~0.3s ease timing.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows only one-way CSS keyframe animations (`fadeIn`, `modalSlideIn`) applied on mount; there is no evidenced exit animation (reverse) when closing/unmounting the modal.
